items.title: China’s U.S.-bound shipments fall in July after brief recovery, survey shows
items.summary: BEIJING — One of the Chinese economy's few growth drivers lost steam in July, according to the latest survey of businesses by China Beige Book.

items.title: Here are the last times the Dow dropped by 1,000 points and what happened next
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell more than 1,000 points on Wednesday after the Federal Reserve decided to keep interest rates steady while U.S. oil neared $85 per barrel.

items.title: China threatens retaliation against U.S. humanoid robot ban, says it 'severely damages' relations
items.summary: BEIJING — The U.S. Federal Communications Commission has repeatedly ignored Beijing's restrained stance on product bans, China's commerce ministry said Thursday, threatening retaliation.

items.title: China's factory activity unexpectedly contracts in July on demand slump, typhoons
items.summary: China's factory activity unexpectedly contracted in July for the first time since February, as domestic orders slumped and typhoons disrupted production, while part of the front-loading momentum began to unwind, piling pressure on Beijing to boost domestic demand.

items.title: U.S. economy slowed to 1.5% growth rate in Q2; June core inflation at 3.3%
items.summary: Economic growth was weaker than expected in the second quarter though underlying drivers were mostly solid.
